translations.web: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”
translations.bsb: Everyone was taken with amazement and glorified God. They were filled with awe and said, “We have seen remarkable things today.”
translations.kjv: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
translations.asv: And amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God; and they were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to-day.
